title: 先留证据：别把生产进程抓崩
premise: 新版本进程内存再次增长，扩大灰度已暂停；决定在恢复前保留诊断资料。
listeningTask: 听清哪些证据来自生产、哪些诊断必须在隔离环境进行。

lines.en: A heap snapshot might help. But taking one can pause this runtime.
lines.zh: 堆快照可能有帮助，但采集时可能暂停这个运行时。

lines.en: It can need extra memory too. This host has very little spare capacity.
lines.zh: 采集也可能需要额外内存，而这台主机余量很小。

lines.en: Maybe start with process stats and logs. Those are much lighter.
lines.zh: 可以先保存进程统计和日志，开销小得多。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no production snapshot without approval, right? Could throttling buy us time?
lines.zh: 我确认一下，未经批准不在生产采快照，对吧？降低消费速率能争取时间吗？

lines.en: Probably. First save the build identifier and the memory timeline.
lines.zh: 可能可以。先保存构建标识和内存变化时间线。

lines.en: I'm on it. We'll take the snapshot in an isolated reproduction instead.
lines.zh: 我来做。快照改在隔离复现环境采集。

lines.en: Use sanitized input. A snapshot can contain customer data and credentials.
lines.zh: 用脱敏输入，快照里可能含客户数据和凭据。

lines.en: What's the ETA for the lightweight evidence? We can't wait for a full reproduction.
lines.zh: 保存轻量证据预计多久？我们不能等完整复现做完才恢复。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on free memory. Stop collection if it makes things worse.
lines.zh: 我会留意空闲内存。如果采集让情况变差，就停止。

lines.en: Two minutes. I'll save only the reviewed logs to restricted storage.
lines.zh: 两分钟。我只把审核过的日志保存到受限存储。

scene: 新版本进程内存再次增长，扩大灰度已暂停；决定在恢复前保留诊断资料。
